name: Gemini
summary: Google's main family of multimodal foundation models. In November 2026 the current generation is Gemini 4 (Argon, Carbon, Hydrogen), with Gemini 3.1 Pro still offered in preview.

name: Gemini Flash and Flash-Lite
summary: The faster, lower-priced Gemini lines. Flash moved through 3.5, 3.6, 3.7 and 3.8 during 2026; Flash-Lite is the cheapest high-volume tier.

name: Nano Banana (Gemini image models)
summary: Gemini models that generate and edit images natively; 'Nano Banana' is the product name Google uses on its price list.

name: Gemini Omni
summary: Any-to-any Gemini models that start with video generation and editing from text, image, video and audio inputs.

name: Gemini Live and audio models
summary: Speech models served through the Live API and related endpoints: native speech-to-speech, text-to-speech, transcription and live translation.

name: Imagen
summary: Google's dedicated text-to-image model line on Google Cloud, priced per image.

name: Veo
summary: Google's dedicated video generation model line, priced per second of generated video.

name: Lyria
summary: Google's music generation model line.

name: Gemini Embedding
summary: Embedding models for retrieval and classification.

name: Gemma
summary: Google's open-weight model family, built from Gemini research and released for self-hosting.

name: Gemini Robotics
summary: Gemini-based models for robots: an embodied-reasoning model that plans and calls tools, and vision-language-action models that control hardware.

name: Genie
summary: Google DeepMind's interactive world models, which generate explorable environments.

name: Gemini 4 Argon
summary: The first Gemini 4 model and Google's broadly available frontier model: built for long multi-step work in software engineering, finance, legal and cyber defence.

howItWorks.text: Input, thinking and output tokens share one 1,048,576-token context window; if input plus the output limit would exceed it, the API caps output to the remaining space.
howItWorks.label: verified-fact

howItWorks.text: Thinking cannot be switched off: the documented levels are low, medium (default) and high, and requesting a thinking budget or a 'minimal' level returns a validation error.
howItWorks.label: verified-fact

inputsOutputs.text: Priced for text, image, video and audio input and text output including reasoning tokens.
inputsOutputs.label: verified-fact

inputsOutputs.text: A normal request returns up to 65,536 output tokens; a background 'long decode' mode can produce up to about 1 million.
inputsOutputs.label: verified-fact

useCases.text: Google positions Argon for long-running coding, multi-document analysis, quantitative finance, legal research and automated vulnerability remediation through CodeMender.
useCases.label: provider-claim

differentiators.text: Google says Argon leads the Vals Index and Harvey's legal agent benchmark and ties for first on CWE-Bench v1 with 68%.
differentiators.label: provider-claim

differentiators.text: Google says Argon is its most resistant model to indirect prompt injection, cutting attack success to 0.7% over 15 adaptive attempts on a Gray Swan benchmark.
differentiators.label: provider-claim

limitations.text: Explicit context caching (cachedContents) is not supported on Gemini 4 Argon; only implicit caching applies.
limitations.label: verified-fact

limitations.text: No free tier on the Gemini Developer API.
limitations.label: verified-fact

limitations.text: Offensive security tasks such as penetration testing are blocked in the standard model; an unrestricted variant is limited to vetted defenders in the Fairwind Program.
limitations.label: provider-claim

unverified: Tool-use and structured-output support were not read from a primary page.
Sources disagree on the non-streaming output cap (32,768 vs 65,536 tokens).

name: Grounding with Google Search
summary: Lets Gemini answer with live Google Search results; billed per search query for Gemini 3 and 4 and per grounded prompt for Gemini 2.x.

name: Grounding with Google Maps
summary: Lets Gemini ground answers in Google Maps data; billed per query after a monthly free allowance.

name: Web Grounding for Enterprise
summary: Enterprise variant of web grounding; for Gemini 3 and 4 it shares the $14 per 1,000 queries rate with Search grounding.

name: Grounding with your data
summary: Grounds Gemini answers in a customer's own data stores, at $2.50 per 1,000 prompts.

name: Provisioned Throughput
summary: Reserved model capacity on Agent Platform bought in generative AI scale units (GSUs) with one-week to one-year commitments.
